$comment: Cannons and cannonballs (docs/CANNONS.md; owner, 2026-11-17). `cannons`: each a block (shared/blocks) whose Use fires it (block data `use: fire`): `ball` the ball it fires (a `balls` name), `muzzleSpeedMs` the ball's speed out of the barrel along the cannon's facing, `muzzleUpM` and `muzzleForwardM` where it leaves (m from the cannon's rear bottom cell's centre: up, and forward along the facing), `reloadS` the least time between shots. `balls`: each a `name`, `radiusM`, `densityKgM3` (steel 7,850: "a heavy steel ball"), and its `impact`: `knock` (the cells within `knockRadiusM` of where it strikes come loose as pieces, at most `maxCells`, none below `minSpeedMs`) or `explode` (an explosive of shared/explosives/explosives.json, by its block, blown where it strikes). Prototype values.
